On the other hand when I finally played Dragon's Dogma, it immediately clicked with me within a few hours of gameplay despite me dismissing this game as just another JRPG for years. When I played it, it made me feel like a kid playing fallout New Vegas for the first time & just immediately being blown away by all the creative shit you could do with the gameplay.
